data.name: Hemanta
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hemant' meaning 'autumn' or 'dark'. It is often associated with the wisdom and knowledge gained during this season. The name Hemanta signifies the end of the monsoon season and the beginning of the winter season, a time of introspection and preparation for the future.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child born during the autumn season, signifying the deep wisdom and knowledge that comes with the changing of the seasons. It is believed that the energy of the autumn season can influence a child's intellectual and emotional growth, making it an ideal name for a child with a strong intellect and a deep connection to spirituality.

He was born in the 13th century in the Indian subcontinent and contributed significantly to the fields of Sanskrit grammar and logic. He wrote several commentaries on various Sanskrit texts and is considered a major figure in the development of the Sanskrit language.
